findings.title: Partial cost sum for mixed priced/unpriced agent rows
findings.problem: hook_usage computes sum(u.source_cost_usd); sum() ignores NULLs, so an agent whose session_usage rows are partly priced (e.g. one model priced, another NULL) gets a partial total rather than unknown.
findings.impact: Bar cost understated and shown as complete. Trigger is narrow: one agent with both priced and unpriced session_usage rows; all-NULL still yields unknown. Reachability of mixed rows was not confirmed.
findings.recommendation: CASE WHEN bool_or(u.source_cost_usd IS NULL) THEN NULL ELSE sum(u.source_cost_usd) END AS cost_usd
